description: Source file implementing utility functions for handling activation functions and unary operations in the MKL-DNN (oneDNN) backend for XPU in PyTorch, including functions to handle argument-less activations, activations requiring scalars, and those requiring algorithms.

methods.name: handle_argument_less
methods.description: Handles unary activation functions that do not require additional arguments, modifying the Attr object accordingly.

methods.name: handle_need_sclars
methods.description: Handles unary activation functions that require scalar arguments, modifying the Attr object accordingly.

methods.name: handle_need_algorithm
methods.description: Handles unary activation functions that require an algorithm parameter, specifically for GELU.

methods.name: construct_unary_attr
methods.description: Constructs and returns an Attr object for unary operations based on the operation type and required arguments.
